title: Modern History, Globalisation and Global Challenges
subject: world

sections.body: Since 1945: the Cold War (USA vs USSR) shaped much of the world until 1991. Dozens of countries became independent. China, India and others grew rapidly.

GLOBALISATION is the growing connection of economies, people and cultures through trade, travel and the internet. It has lifted many out of poverty but also brought job losses in some places, and spread problems quickly (like pandemics).
Global challenges include climate change, inequality, pandemics and the impact of new technology like AI. In 2015, UN members agreed 17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) to tackle them by 2030.
